text:
Dallas fans remember Joel Kiviranta for one night: the Game 7 hat trick that knocked Colorado out of the 2020 playoffs. After three seasons with the Avalanche, he came back on a one-year deal this summer, and through 15 games he looks like exactly what the Stars paid for: a depth forward on about 12 minutes a night who keeps things level. Dallas has taken 50% of the shot attempts and 50% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) at five on five with him on the ice.

The scoring is modest and honest. He has two goals on 2.1 expected and three points, with his shooting right at the league rate. Nothing is running hot or cold, and 15 games is a small sample. His real value last season came without the puck: Evolving-Hockey had most of his worth from the penalty kill and opponents getting fewer chances against him than against 90% of forwards, though it also notes he played with very strong teammates in Colorado. That is the part to watch in Dallas, where the help around him is good but the minutes are fewer. Our range for his full season is 7 to 16 goals.
headline: Joel Kiviranta is back in Dallas and holding steady
